mapper.sql: r.id AS id, r.payment_key AS paymentKey, r.order_seq AS orderSeq, r.moid AS moid, r.tid AS tid, r.amount AS amount, r.status AS status, r.fail_code AS failCode, r.fail_message AS failMessage, r.expired_at AS expiredAt, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_transaction (payment_key, order_seq, moid, tid, amount, status, expired_at) VALUES (#{paymentKey}, #{orderSeq}, #{moid}, #{tid}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{expiredAt})
